entities.name: Equity Inflows
entities.brief: Resurgence in equity inflows led by client buying
entities.description: Represents renewed increase in equity inflows across sectors driven by retail and hedge fund clients

entities.name: Table T1 – Equity Inflows: Utilities outflows; ETF inflows
entities.brief: Utilities sector cumulative ETF and single stock flows 2017-2024
entities.description: Highlights sustained utility stock outflows and volatile but modest ETF flows over time

properties.key_insight: Utilities single stock flows show sustained large cumulative outflows, while ETF flows fluctuated near zero with peaks around $900mn and troughs near -$800mn

entities.name: Table T2 – Equity Inflows: Real Estate net buy swings
entities.brief: Real Estate sector cumulative ETF and single stock net buys 2016-2024
entities.description: Shows volatile single stock swings and sustained ETF outflows in Real Estate from 2016 to 2024

properties.key_insight: Real Estate single stock flows swung from deep cumulative outflows to inflows around mid-2022 before reversing back to outflows by late 2024, while ETF flows remained consistently negative

entities.name: Table T3 – Equity Inflows: Utilities long-term outflows vs ETFs
entities.brief: Utilities sector long-term ETF and single stock flows 2016-2024
entities.description: Illustrates sustained single stock outflows and relatively flat ETF accumulation over the long term

properties.key_insight: Utilities single stock flows show accelerating long-term cumulative outflows reaching nearly -$8bn by 2024, while ETF flows peaked around $1.8bn in 2020 then fluctuated near zero
